root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Without mapper entries, the app never receives tool-call-start envelopes for these tools; the knownTools registry is not consulted; no card renders.

protocol_blocked_tools.note: These 7 tools are blocked by codexAppServerClient.ts:280-364. The client only translates 3 Codex item.type values into EventMsg: commandExecution, fileChange, agentMessage. All other item types hit the catch-all at line 364 (return method.startsWith('item/')) and are silently consumed without generating any EventMsg. No mapper branches can route to these tools because no EventMsg with these tool names ever reaches sessionProtocolMapper.ts.
